g.text: every gate · pinned, dated, signed · the liquor stays in the pocket until the lot is certified
tests that passed yesterday still pass today · no silent breakage
change in spec A doesn't quietly break a contract in spec B
authn/authz, OWASP top-10, dependency audit, secret hygiene
bug-fix test FAILS without fix, PASSES with fix · no tautology
iterate picks newest qualifying work · no stale specs forever
deterministic ordering · no agent gets stuck choosing what next
bug fixers must show the bug breaks the system before fixing
repro + impact + suspected cause filed before dispatch
★ THE FAILURE-PRONE FIVE — agents skip these and shit hits the trailer:
G013 anti-fabrication · G016 raw evidence · G027 status ceiling · G028 implementation reality · G036 adversarial regression
PHASE COLOR KEY · which crew owns enforcement
